purpose: Phase 1 — source archive and exam identity audit for the 1396–1405 master's 1142 and doctoral 2162 examination sets.

masters.definition: The standard master's Management examination set 1142. All printed subject sections inside this exam set must be covered; the eight-course application subset is not the whole booklet.
masters.exclusionNote: These are separate examination-set codes and are not silently folded into 1142. Expand the project scope only through an explicit scope decision.

doctoral.domainLabel: PhD Management exam family (historically multi-code; later consolidated under 2162)
doctoral.interpretation: Do not treat the one 2162 file per year as complete doctoral Management coverage. In 1401–1402 multiple management disciplines were separate exam-set codes; by 1404–1405 the official guides place many of these tracks under umbrella code 2162 using course-combination codes. See the historical code-family registry.

doctoral.migrationCaveat: Exact code maps for 1396–1400 and transition evidence for 1403 still require official guide/amendment reconciliation. No older code is assigned to 2162 by title similarity alone.
doctoral.scopeCaveat: The initial 10 doctoral package rows represent only existing 2162 OCR candidates. A full historical doctoral Management inventory must add a separate booklet/source identity for every exam code or course combination in the year-specific guide.

extendedRelatedManagementTitledExamSets.rule: Separate Sports Sciences exam family; never merge with 2162.

officialGuideEvidenceByYear.evidence: Year-specific guide confirms codes 2162–2169, 2170 Tourism and 2171 Finance. The adjacent Educational Management heading has an OCR inconsistency (one heading reads 2143, another 1423) and remains probable pending page-image verification.
Separate codes 2162–2169, 2171 and separately labelled 2143/2115; Tourism 2170 and Accounting 2172 are also distinct.
Official selection guide confirms 2162 Management with course combinations 1–7 and separate 2166/2168.

doctoral.codeReuseWarning: Codes are year-specific and context-specific. For example, Accounting is a separate exam set 2172 in 1400 and 2173 in 1402; 1399 guide does not verify an Accounting exam-set code. The 1399 Public Management 2163 table also uses numeric 2170–2175 as course-location codes, while its separate exam-set headings 2170 and 2171 mean Tourism and Finance.

scope.scopeCaveat: The present 20-package plan is explicitly limited to 1142 and 2162. It must not be described as every Iranian exam set containing the word «مدیریت».
scope.auditUnitDefinition: The 20 rows in `packages[]` are parent year-level records only (10 master's 1142 + 10 doctoral 2162 OCR records). They are not a count of all original doctoral Management exam booklets. The complete doctoral inventory must expand each year into historical examSetCode and/or 2162 courseCombinationCode units.

summary.statusWarning: The 20 `packages[]` rows are year-level parent records, not the final count of doctoral Management exam booklets. The existing PhD OCR subset only follows code 2162; a historical multi-code/course-combination expansion is now required. `eligible` remains a staging status, not official verification, complete question extraction, key verification or republication permission.

summary.completeBroadDoctoralManagementInventory: not_enumerated; core historical code family plus adjacent management-named exam sets identified but full source-unit inventory not yet counted
